fullPassage: A greater sensitivity and concern towards the welfare and wellbeing of the natural environment and ecological systems are contributing to shifts in people's feelings about other animals. Images of animals are used by activist organizations to provoke strong affective responses as part of initiatives to fight animal cruelty. Among wild animals, koalas are often to be found in 'cute animal' digital portrayals and are strategically used as charismatic flagship species in conservation awareness and fundraising efforts. While cute affects play some role in these affective connections, broader ethical principles concerning animal rights and the awe-inspiring power and beauty of nature are central to these transformations. A notable move towards attunement to issues such as animal welfare in farming, the horse racing industry and the fur industry, together with heightened awareness of the environmental impacts of factory farming, is evident in countries comprising the Global North. Many people have adopted an ethical stance on the treatment and use of animals and are changing their consumption habits accordingly. Practices such as the adoption of organic, vegetarian and vegan diets are also expanding rapidly in response to concern about animal welfare and environmental sustainability.

❌ ④ deeper(더 깊은): 차원이 다른 형용사로 반의어가 아님
det.tip: broader ↔ narrower. '더 넓은 원칙' vs '더 좁은 원칙'의 대비이다.

questions.passage: A greater sensitivity and concern towards the welfare and wellbeing of the natural environment and ecological systems are contributing to shifts in people's feelings about other animals. Images of animals are used by activist organizations to provoke strong affective responses as part of initiatives to fight animal cruelty. Among wild animals, koalas are often to be found in 'cute animal' digital portrayals and are strategically used as charismatic flagship species in conservation awareness and fundraising efforts. While cute affects play some role in these affective connections, broader ethical principles concerning animal rights and the awe-inspiring power and beauty of nature are central to these transformations. A notable move towards attunement to issues such as animal welfare in farming, the horse racing industry and the fur industry, together with <u>heightened</u> awareness of the environmental impacts of factory farming, is evident in countries comprising the Global North. Many people have adopted an ethical stance on the treatment and use of animals and are changing their consumption habits accordingly. Practices such as the adoption of organic, vegetarian and vegan diets are also expanding rapidly in response to concern about animal welfare and environmental sustainability.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 heightened와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ reduced(줄어든): heightened의 반의어로 가장 적절
❌ ① increased(증가한): heightened의 유의어
❌ ② intensified(강화된): heightened의 유의어
❌ ③ elevated(높아진): heightened의 유의어
det.tip: heightened ↔ reduced / diminished. '고조된 인식' vs '줄어든 인식'의 대비이다.

questions.passage:

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 animal의 의미로 가장 적절하게 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① (A)에서 'animals'는 코알라 등 실제 동물을 가리키며 '짐승 같은 사람'이 아님
✅ ② (A) 자연환경의 생물학적 '동물' / (B) 한계를 넘어 혹사당한 '짐승 같은 존재'
❌ ③ 둘 다 '짐승 같은 사람'이면 (A)의 보전 활동 맥락과 맞지 않음
❌ ④ (B)에서 극도로 지친 상태를 비유적으로 표현하므로 단순 '동물'이 아님
det.tip: animal은 명사로 '동물', 비유적으로 '짐승 같은 존재/사람'의 다의어이다. 본문에서는 실제 동물(코알라 등)을 의미한다.

ch: (A) 짐승 같은 사람 - (B) 짐승 같은 사람

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the quality of being able to continue over a period of time without causing damage to the environment"

det.analysis:
✅ ③ sustainability(지속 가능성): 환경에 손상을 주지 않으면서 일정 기간 지속될 수 있는 특성을 뜻함
❌ ① awareness(인식): 어떤 것을 알고 있는 상태이며 환경 지속성과는 다름
❌ ② attunement(동조): 특정 이슈에 대한 민감한 반응이며 정의와 다름
❌ ④ sensitivity(민감성): 외부 자극에 반응하는 특성이며 정의와 다름
det.tip: sustainability는 'environmental sustainability(환경적 지속 가능성)'처럼 환경 보전과 관련된 핵심 어휘이다.

questions.passage: A notable move towards attunement to issues such as animal welfare in farming, the horse racing industry and the fur industry, together with __________ (heighten) awareness of the environmental impacts of factory farming, is evident in countries comprising the Global North.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 과거분사 형태가 명사 awareness를 수식해야 한다.
det.analysis: 명사 'awareness'를 수식하는 형용사 자리이므로 동사 'heighten'을 과거분사 'heightened'로 바꿔야 한다. 'heightened awareness'는 '고조된 인식'이라는 뜻으로 수동/완료의 의미를 가진다.
det.tip: 동사 heighten → 과거분사 heightened. heightened awareness(고조된 인식)는 빈출 연어 표현이다.

questions.passage: Many people have adopted an ethical stance on the __________ (treat) and use of animals and are changing their consumption habits accordingly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 전치사 'on the' 뒤에는 명사 형태가 와야 한다.
det.analysis: 전치사 'on the' 뒤이므로 동사 'treat'를 명사형 'treatment'로 바꿔야 한다. 'the treatment and use of animals'는 '동물의 처우와 이용'이라는 의미의 명사구이다.
det.tip: 동사 treat → 명사 treatment. the treatment of animals(동물의 처우)는 동물 복지 논의의 핵심 어휘이다.
